additional_info.subject: ID0429032-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/PN 312562229/10] Technical Error CRM:00798002189
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
We need to plan for the site intervention.
We could see Error Code 04 over the converters.
Which implies that there is AC open Phase.
We need to check if there is issue in the Bus bar from the RFI filter to the converter.
We have analyzed the charger, and we suspect there is issue in the Fast Shutdown line.
Pls check and validate Highlighted connections as per schematics.
Charger is on FW v6.1.3, Ensure to update charger to latest FW i.e. v7.0.5.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0429032 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Yes
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
